name: amfx-us-financial-conditions-research
description: amFX reproduction (24JAN23 p6): US Financial Conditions Index (Chicago Fed NFCI, negated to match Bloomberg convention: positive = loose, negative = tight). Shows how financial conditions eased back to Feb 2022 levels by Jan 2023, despite aggressive Fed hikes. The V-shaped recovery from trough undermined the 'tightening is working' narrative.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: US FINANCIAL CONDITIONS INDEX (24JAN23 p6)
# =============================================================================
# Chicago Fed NFCI (weekly) negated to match Bloomberg convention:
#   positive = loose, negative = tight
# =============================================================================

# Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index (weekly)
nfci_src = economic_indicators(series_id='NFCI')()
nfci_filled = ffill(nfci_src.result)

# Negate to match Bloomberg convention (positive = loose)
fci = 0.0 - nfci_filled

idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='US Financial Conditions: How Tight Is Policy Really?',
    category='Financial Conditions',
    y_axis_label='Index (positive = loose)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Financial Conditions (neg. NFCI)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Neutral', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, fci)
